Hierarchical clustering of TCRs by TCRdist

Source: R/hierarchical.R
tcrdist_hclust.Rd

Convenience wrapper that computes the pairwise TCRdist matrix and performs hierarchical clustering via stats::hclust().

Usage

tcrdist_hclust(tcr_df, organism, method = "average", max_tcrs = 2000L)

Arguments

tcr_df

Data.frame with TCR columns.

organism

Character string ("human" or "mouse").

method

Clustering method for stats::hclust(). Default "average" (UPGMA).

max_tcrs

Integer. Subsample if N exceeds this. Default 2000L.

Value

A named list:

hclust

An hclust object.

dist_matrix

The pairwise distance matrix used.

indices

Integer vector of row indices used (after potential subsampling).

See also

cluster_tcrs, neighborhood_test, plot_tcrdist_dendrogram

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
result <- tcrdist_hclust(tcr_df, "human")
plot(result$hclust)
clusters <- cutree(result$hclust, k = 5)
} # }
